description: Enrichment pipeline for NiFi system diagnostics - normalizes percentages and parses nested structures

script.source: if (ctx.usedHeapBytes != null && ctx.maxHeapBytes != null && ctx.maxHeapBytes > 0) { ctx.heapUtilization = (ctx.usedHeapBytes / (double)ctx.maxHeapBytes) * 100.0; }

if (ctx.storageUsage != null) { for (storage in ctx.storageUsage) { if (storage.usedBytes != null && storage.totalBytes != null && storage.totalBytes > 0) { storage.utilizationPercent = (storage.usedBytes / (double)storage.totalBytes) * 100.0; } } }

if (ctx.gcStats != null) { if (ctx.gcStats.collectionCount != null && ctx.gcStats.collectionMillis != null && ctx.gcStats.collectionCount > 0) { ctx.gcStats.avgCollectionDuration = ctx.gcStats.collectionMillis / (double)ctx.gcStats.collectionCount; } }
